How to use this template

- Fill in every applicable section. Delete a section that does not apply rather
  than leaving it empty.
- Description: say what is missing or wrong today, and why it matters.
  Do not restate the title.
- Scope is optional: name the command(s) and flag(s) when the request is
  specific to them. Delete the section otherwise.
- Requirements are acceptance criteria, one per bullet, phrased so each can be
  checked from the command line. Keep them implementation-agnostic: say what
  must be true, not which file changes.
- Open Questions is for decisions you want input on before work starts.
- Cite related issues inline in the prose, for example "Depends on the base
  branch being resolved after the fetch; see #123".
-->
